The middle portion of the lands will be redesignated from "Agricultural Area" to "General Employment" and will be rezoned from A Agricultural Zone to EM2(H) General Employment Area Zone with the addition of the Holding Symbol "(H)" and OS1 Open Space Conservation Zone. Associated implementing documents will be brought forward to the now LPAT at a later date.

The final decision and order have been withheld pending the settlement of the details of the Site Development Application and any conditions.
